title: fix: reward private fallbacks at served price
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps the caller charge fixed to the requested public listing price
- Calculates the owner reward from the private fallback's own served price
- Preserves the existing 75% reward rate and validates a cheaper fallback

Follow-up to #13736

gist.headline: Fair pollen for fallback work
gist.blurb: Private fallback providers now get their pollen measured from the model that actually served the request. The public price stays put; the reward math has stopped admiring the wrong flower.
gist.summary: Fixed private fallback reward tracking so callers remain charged the requested public listing price while fallback owners receive 75% of their own lower served price.
gist.impact: Users keep predictable public model pricing, while private fallback providers are rewarded accurately when their cheaper model handles a request.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden bookkeeper wearing tiny round accountant glasses, weighing two labeled pollen jars: a public-price sign remains fixed for the caller while a smaller private fallback flower receives its correctly measured 75% reward. A cozy retro terminal and code-plants make the request-routing and tracking context clear.
